name: Shadow Web
author: ulinycoin
description: Agent-facing web interaction toolkit. Compress HTML to action maps, drive browsers via Playwright, extract structured data (tables, forms, lists), search the web, and fill forms — all from MCP.

tools.name: agent_run
tools.description: Thick tool: run a bounded browser TASK server-side and return one JSON result.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click element by data-sid on the current page.

tools.name: compress_html
tools.description: Compress raw HTML into clean markup, flat action map, and semantic groups.

tools.name: compress_html_to_xml
tools.description: Return grouped XML action map for raw HTML (no browser).

tools.name: content_blocks
tools.description: Fetch content blocks from the current page by comma-separated IDs.

tools.name: content_outline
tools.description: Build a terse content outline from the current browser session.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Fill input by data-sid on the current page.

tools.name: form_fill_execute
tools.description: Execute form fill plan. Use answers JSON for ask steps. Returns status + filled/handoffs/questions.

tools.name: form_fill_plan
tools.description: Build AgentOps form fill plan from profile JSON. Optional url navigates first.

tools.name: get_page_html
tools.description: Return clean HTML from the current browser session.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open URL in Playwright and build grouped XML Action Map snapshot.

tools.name: query_page
tools.description: Alias for shadow_query(format=json). Requires navigate first.

tools.name: schema_csv
tools.description: Export HTML table as CSV: "Name,Age,Email

tools.name: schema_form
tools.description: Extract form schema from HTML: action, method, fields with types and validation.

tools.name: schema_json
tools.description: Export HTML table as JSON records: [{"Name": "Alice", "Age": 30}, ...].

tools.name: schema_list
tools.description: Extract lists from HTML: unordered, ordered, or standalone select with items.

tools.name: schema_page
tools.description: Extract ALL structured data (tables, forms, lists) from HTML at once.

tools.name: schema_session
tools.description: Extract structured data from the current browser session (tables, forms, lists).

tools.name: schema_session_csv
tools.description: Export table from current browser session as CSV. Requires navigate/snapshot first.

tools.name: schema_session_json
tools.description: Export table from current browser session as JSON records. Requires navigate/snapshot first.

tools.name: schema_table
tools.description: Extract structured table data from HTML: columns, types, and rows.

tools.name: shadow_grep_html
tools.description: Run shadow_grep on raw HTML without a browser session.

tools.name: shadow_query
tools.description: shadow_grep — filter current page actions before sending to LLM.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Refresh current page snapshot. Set diff=True for delta XML after first snapshot.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web via Brave Search (Yahoo fallback). No API keys required.

tools.name: webmcp_execute_tool
tools.description: Execute a WebMCP tool by name. arguments: JSON object string.

tools.name: webmcp_list_tools
tools.description: Detect WebMCP tools on the current page (Chrome 145+ preview).
